intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in St. Charles, from the wall out
paragraphs: Aptitude Design & Build does kitchen remodeling in St. Charles and across the St. Louis area from its shop on South 5th Street. Many of their kitchens start with a structural question. On one St. Charles home, the wall between kitchen and family room held up the whole second floor. The crew shored it up, set a new beam, and built an oversized island with a second prep sink where the wall used to be.

Because the builders sit in on design, layout ideas get priced and checked for structure early, not after demolition. That matters in older St. Louis houses, where plaster walls, old wiring and earlier remodels can hide behind the cabinets. Google reviewers describe excellent service, great communication and attention to detail from bid to final walk-through.

services.h2: Remodeling services for St. Charles and St. Louis homes

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Custom cabinetry, islands, wall removal and open-concept layouts, walk-in pantries, custom range hoods, coffee bars, lighting and plumbing updates. The team asks first whether your current layout works, so you only pay to move what needs moving. Most kitchens take 8 to 12 weeks of construction.

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners from Ballwin to Ladue pick Aptitude

items.title: Comfortable with structural work
items.text: Load-bearing walls, new beams, moved plumbing and relocated doorways are routine here. The St. Charles open-concept kitchen required temporary shoring for the whole second floor before the wall came out.

items.title: Builders in the design meetings
items.text: The people who build your project help plan it, so feasibility, selections and budget are weighed together before work begins instead of being discovered during demolition.

items.title: Noticed by local press
items.text: Aptitude has been featured in the St. Louis Business Journal, St. Louis Magazine, Ladue News and St. Louis Magazine's Faces of Exceptional Remodeling.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: Reviewers on Google include returning clients, and the owner's reply to one review thanks a family for trusting the team again with another interior transformation.

about.h2: A word from founder Matt Mierek
about.text: Matt Mierek founded Aptitude and serves as its president. He describes his team as craftsmen who want long-term relationships with clients, not one-and-done jobs, and says that mindset has been part of the company's DNA from the start. In an interview with Ladue News he explained the goal of simplifying remodeling so it is enjoyable for clients. Homeowners on Google say Matt was helpful and knowledgeable through the bid process, and they mention foreman Terry by name. The firm also handles commercial build-outs, offices and apartment remodels across the region.

image.alt: Matt Mierek, founder and president of Aptitude Design & Build in St. Charles, MO

process.h2: The Aptitude kitchen process, step by step

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Talk through what is not working, what you want to change and your expected investment, so goals and budget line up from day one.

steps.title: Design and layout planning
steps.text: Explore layouts, islands, cabinetry, appliance placement and lighting, and answer the big question of how the kitchen can work better.

steps.title: Selections and budgeting
steps.text: Choose cabinets, counters, flooring, fixtures and appliances with the budget in view, since design and construction are priced together.

steps.title: Pre-construction and permits
steps.text: Plans, scheduling, trade coordination, ordering and permits are lined up before demolition so the build runs smoothly.

steps.title: Build and final walk-through
steps.text: A dedicated project manager runs construction from demolition to finish carpentry, then a final walk-through closes out remaining details.

service_area.h2: Working across St. Charles and St. Louis County
service_area.text: Aptitude is based at 912 S 5th St in St. Charles and remodels homes on both sides of the Missouri River. Recent and listed communities include St. Charles, St. Louis, Clayton, Ladue, Frontenac, Chesterfield, Kirkwood, Town & Country, Creve Coeur, Des Peres, Webster Groves, Richmond Heights, Wildwood, Ballwin, the Central West End, Holly Hills and South City.

items.q: Can you take out a wall to open up my kitchen?
items.a: Often, yes. On a St. Charles kitchen the wall between kitchen and family room carried the entire second floor. The team temporarily supported the structure, installed a new beam and support system, and turned two closed rooms into one open space with a large island.

items.q: How long will my kitchen be out of commission?
items.a: Most kitchen remodels take about 8 to 12 weeks once construction begins. Keeping the existing footprint usually takes less time than moving plumbing or walls. Design, selections, cabinet ordering and permits happen before demolition, so starting those talks early helps the schedule.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost around St. Louis?
items.a: Aptitude says most bathroom remodels in the St. Louis area range from $15,000 to $80,000. Guest bath updates sit near the low end. Primary baths with custom tile, freestanding tubs, heated floors or expanded layouts need a larger budget. Construction usually takes 4 to 8 weeks.

items.q: Do you handle permits and inspections?
items.a: Yes. Permitting is part of pre-construction planning, and the team manages permits and inspections for projects throughout St. Louis, St. Charles and surrounding communities. Plans, trade scheduling and material orders are coordinated at the same time so work can start cleanly.

items.q: Can you remodel an older St. Louis home without losing its character?
items.a: Yes. Older homes may hide uneven floors, old wiring, plaster walls or earlier renovations, and the team plans for those. Cabinetry, millwork, flooring, lighting and proportions are chosen so the new kitchen still fits the architecture of the house.

final_cta.h2: Ready to open up your kitchen?
final_cta.text: Call Matt's team in St. Charles to talk through your layout, structure and budget.
